title: Amazon and Google AI Allegedly Promote Mein Kampf as 'a True Work of Art' in Search Results

behaviors.text: Amazon's AI-generated review summary allegedly misrepresented customer feedback on Mein Kampf by describing it as "a true work of art." Google's search algorithm then surfaced this misleading AI-generated text as a featured snippet, which in turn amplified the error.
This incident arose from AI summarizing AI-generated content, in effect creating a self-reinforcing misinformation loop.
